products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Man Pure Parfum
products.body_html:
Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Man Pure Parfum is a bold and powerful fragrance for men, launched in 2021. It has become one of the most talked-about scents in the men’s fragrance world for its rich, smoky, and masculine aroma. Inspired by the luxury scent of Creed Aventus, this perfume opens with a sharp, citrusy blast and slowly transforms into a deep, woody experience. It’s perfect for men who prefer their perfume to be strong, long-lasting, and full of personality.


This version of the Pure Parfum is the most refined and intense in the Club De Nuit Intense range, offering a smooth yet powerful aroma that’s perfect for both daily use and special occasions.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Ice Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Ice Eau De Parfum is a fresh and aromatic perfume for men. Launched in 2023, it opens with a burst of fruity and citrus notes of apple, Italian lemon, Sicilian bergamot and star anise. The middle contains majesty plum, orange blossom and cardamom, giving a sweet and spicy impression, while the base leaves a warm musk, amber, driftwood and moss trail that is long lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum is a warm, spicy, and irresistibly sweet unisex fragrance that is an oriental charm with a modern twist. Known for its rich cinnamon and vanilla profile, Khamrah is a bold scent inspired by Arabian traditions and global luxury tastes. Often compared to high-end niche perfumes, Lattafa Khamrah offers an affordable alternative without compromising on quality or performance. This perfume is ideal for people who enjoy strong, lasting fragrances with a warm, dessert-like aroma.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Blue Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Turathi Blue is a crisp, fresh, and uplifting scent crafted for the modern man. It starts with a burst of zesty bergamot and mandarin, creating an energizing first impression. The scent then drifts into warm amber, entwined with woody nuances, before finally resting on a base of smooth musk and patchouli with a touch of spice. Ideal for everyday wear, it is both refined and approachable with a touch of Middle Eastern richness.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Marwa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Marwa Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern citrus aromatic men’s perfume for those who like clean, bright scents. It opens with juicy citrus notes that feel sharp, fresh and very uplifting. As it settles, warm spices and soft florals come in, giving it a smooth and balanced heart. The base is calm, woody and slightly smoky, with a clean tea note that stays classy on skin.

products.title: Afnan  Modest Une Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Modest Une Eau de Parfum is a modern men’s fragrance that was launched in 2019. It is an aromatic spicy combination made for men who like fresh, bold and long-lasting perfumes. The opening comes with sharp pepper, soothing lavender, cool mint and spicy nutmeg. The middle notes bring citrus, warm amber and refreshing eucalyptus. The base is masculine with musk, vetiver and cedarwood giving it depth and strength that stays for hours.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Imagination Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Imagination Eau De Parfum is a bright and modern citrus aromatic scent made for men who like fresh, clean and a bit warm type perfumes. The aroma begins with a silky blend of citron, bergamot, and orange, then transitions to soft neroli, spicy ginger, and cinnamon which feels warm but still fresh. The lower notes are stronger with Chinese black tea, ambroxan, guaiac wood, and olibanum that remain on the skin for a long time and impart a luxurious and soothing aura.

products.title: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum is a bright, fresh, and modern unisex fragrance that mixes juicy citrus with smooth woods and soft musk. Inspired by sunny days and easy elegance, this perfume opens with a splash of zesty Sicilian lemon, refreshing bergamot, and a hint of spicy black currant. As it settles, fruity notes blend with soft jasmine and earthy patchouli leaf, adding depth and charm. The dry-down is warm and creamy with cedar, leather, vanilla, and white musk that stay on your skin for hours.

Mancera Cedrat Boise is a perfect everyday fragrance for people who love fresh, energetic scents with a classy twist. It feels youthful yet sophisticated, making it a favourite for both men and women who want to smell fresh, clean, and stylish all day long.

products.title: Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum is a bold, fresh, and sensual men’s fragrance inspired by the Greek god of love Eros. Just like its name, this perfume is all about passion and power. It opens with an amazing blast of mint, sweet candy apple, and zesty citrus fruits. As it settles, warm ambroxan and fresh geranium add depth and masculinity. Finally, a smooth blend of vanilla, cedar, and leather wraps you in a warm, confident finish.

Versace Eros Man Eau De Parfum is perfect for modern men who want to feel strong, attractive, and unforgettable. A few sprays will boost your confidence and turn heads wherever you go.

products.title: Lattafa Al Nashma Caprice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Nashma Caprice Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. Its launch in 2024 revealed the mixture of spicy, citrus, and woody notes in a fresh and elegant perfume. The composition starts with the lively cardamom, ginger, bergamot, and lemon that serve the energetic and clean opening. Lavender, geranium, and mint form the middle, with their soft, herbal, and calming touch added to the composition. The base is composed of amber, cedarwood, patchouli, and vetiver that create a warm and smooth long-lasting dry down on skin.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau de Parfum is an appealing, sophisticated, and intense fragrance that is suitable for men during the evening. The top note is a soft and smooth burst of bergamot which is quickly replaced by the combination of creamy and powdery iris note alongside roasted chestnut in the heart. The base note consists of the likes of whiskey, wood, and amber which makes the overall feel sweet, boozy, and warm. The scent gives out luxury, elegance, and romance. Besides, it is an ideal fragrance for the cold nights, dinners, dates, and other romantic occasions.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Man Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Man Eau De Toilette is a classic men’s perfume known for its cool, fresh and confident vibe. Launched in 1988, it’s still a favorite for those who love clean and ocean-like scents. It starts with a mix of mint, green notes, lavender and rosemary, giving a crisp freshness, then brings soft hints of sandalwood, jasmine, and geranium. Finally, the base adds depth with musk, cedar, ambergris and tobacco, making it long lasting, masculine and refreshing all day.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Silver Shade Eau De Parfum is a fresh, modern, and energetic unisex fragrance that feels like a cool mountain breeze in a bottle. This scent is designed for the stylish individual who loves a clean and uplifting aroma. It beautifully balances zesty citrus fruits with soft florals and a clean, musky base, creating a perfectly refreshing and sophisticated experience.

Silver Shade smells yet smooth, with a touch of class that makes it incredibly versatile. It’s the perfect choice for anyone who wants a signature scent that is easy to wear daily but still makes a statement. A spray of Ajmal Silver Shade will leave you feeling confident, fresh, and ready to conquer your day with effortless style.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim Eau De Parfum is a bright, juicy and refreshing citrus scent made for people who love clean and energetic summer perfumes. It opens with a strong blast of mandarin and orange that feels like fresh sunshine on skin. The bergamot adds a soft sparkle, while ginger and ambergris give it a warm, salty, slightly sweet twist that dries down clean.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is an elegant oriental fragrance for both men and women. Inspired by rich Arabic traditions and royal gatherings, this scent wraps you in warmth, sweetness, and a soft floral touch.

Bin Shaikh combines the beauty of fresh roses, exotic saffron, and earthy oak moss with a sweet heart of bakhoor, sugar, jasmine, and violet. The dry down is deep and comforting with oud, amber, ambroxan, musk, and patchouli creating a luxurious trail.

Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is perfect for those who love sweet, woody scents with a hint of floral freshness. Just a few sprays make you feel confident, royal, and ready for any special moment.

products.title: Armaf Tres Nuit Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Tres Nuit Eau de Parfum is a fresh and spicy scent made specially for men. It opens bright with lemon, iris, and vervain, giving a citrusy and green start. The middle notes move into lavender, violet, and some spicy touches that make it elegant and smooth. At the base, ambergris and sandalwood bring depth and warmth, making it a timeless perfume that feels both clean and classy.

products.title: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette is a fresh and strong men’s fragrance that feels clean, modern, and confident. It opens with a cool splash of bergamot, grapefruit, and watery notes that feel very fresh on skin. Slowly, it moves into a spicy and slightly woody heart with black pepper and ambroxan. The base feels warm and smooth with musk, incense, and tonka bean. This scent feels masculine, stylish, and perfect for daily wear.

products.title: Calvin Klein Ck One Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein CK One Eau de Toilette is one of the most famous unisex perfume in the world which was launched in 1994 it brings a fresh and clean vibe that feels natural on both men and women. The Fragrance starts with citrus fruits like lemon, bergamot and mandarin orange, mixed with pineapple, green notes, cardamom and papaya and the middle brings a soft floral touch with jasmine, violet, rose, freesia, lily of the valley, nutmeg and orris root. The base is warm and balanced with green tea, sandalwood, musk, cedar, oakmoss, amber and green accords. CK One is simple, cool and made for everyday wear.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette is one of the most talked-about scents in the men’s fragrance world which was released in 2015 it has a sharp, fresh and bold profile that combines fruity, floral and woody notes in one bottle. The perfume starts with a blast of lemon, pineapple, bergamot, black currant and apple giving a citrusy yet sweet start. The middle slowly brings in smoky birch, soft jasmine and gentle rose. The endnotes are smooth and long-lasting with musk, ambergris, patchouli and a touch of vanilla which adds warmth and depth.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum is a unisex fragrance launched in 2020. It is a bright and fresh perfume that opens with citrus and fruity notes of bergamot, lemon, black currant, lime, violet leaf, and ginger. The middle notes are soft florals like rose, iris, and jasmine and the final notes settle into a classy combination of ambroxan, musk, sandalwood, and cedar. It is a fragrance that feels clean, modern, and versatile, perfect for everyday wear or special evenings.

products.title: Rue Broca Theoreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Théoreme Eau de Parfum is a fresh, warm perfume for men, and simultaneously clean, spicy and smooth. It plays out with bright citrus that provides a sharp and energetic opening. Gradually, the amber and woody tones appear, bringing the warmth and richness. The musk, spices and patchouli in the dry down leave a strong and lasting trail. It is contemporary, secure and comfortable.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and modern unisex fragrance that beautifully blends fruity sweetness with soft floral touches and warm woody notes. Inspired by royalty and calm blue skies, this scent opens with juicy pear and sweet citrus notes that instantly lift your mood.

At its heart, Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum blooms with freesia and rose, giving a clean and graceful floral vibe. The base is warm and comforting with soft musk and smooth cedarwood, adding depth and a gentle touch of luxury that stays with you all day.

If you love fragrances that feel light yet royal, Azure Royal is a perfect choice for daily wear, special dinners, and every moment you want to feel fresh and confident.

products.title: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by the house of Lattafa. It is a classy and modern scent with a nice mix of citrus, woods and spice. The perfume opens fresh with lemon, bergamot, clary sage and juniper berries, giving a cool and clean feeling. As it settles, white tea, sandalwood, cardamom and olibanum bring warmth and smoothness. The dry down has ambergris, cedarwood, cashmeran and patchouli that make it deep, cozy, and long-lasting.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum
products.body_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum stands as a modern, profound interpretation of the legendary Acqua Di Gio collection. It masterfully achieves balance by merging the invigorating freshness of marine notes with the inherent richness of woody undertones, resulting in a fragrance that projects both purity and significant power. 

The opening sequence delivers the bright, airy freshness of marine notes and bergamot, creating an initial impression reminiscent of a clean sea breeze and crisp citrus. This evolves into an aromatic core of rosemary, clary sage, and geranium, which introduces a distinct herbal depth. Finally, the scent anchors itself with warm notes of olibanum and patchouli, providing a grounded, lasting, and deeply masculine trail. Crafted by master perfumer Alberto Morillas, this fragrance is built on a foundation of clean, confident, and enduring sophistication, making it an ideal choice for the man who values an effortlessly elegant and timeless scent.

products.title: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume from the house of Afnan which was released in 2022. It is built around a fresh and spicy DNA with sparkling citrus, spices and woody accords. The perfume starts with grapefruit, pink pepper, juniper and cardamom, all are the top notes of this perfume. The middle notes are Calabrian bergamot, cedar, nutmeg and jasmine and the final notes are ambergris, apple, musk and patchouli for a deep long-lasting impression. This fragrance is designed as a versatile everyday signature with a balance of fresh energy and warm sensuality.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy in Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy in Heaven Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean, and classy fragrance for men who love to feel cool and confident. Inspired by clear blue skies and a fresh breeze, Afnan Supremacy in Heaven brings together citrus and green notes with a smooth woody base.

This fragrance feels like wearing a crisp white shirt on a sunny day, simple yet very sophisticated. With every spray of Afnan Supremacy in Heaven, you get a burst of fresh bergamot and mandarin orange, followed by soothing green tea and black currant. The base of musk and sandalwood keeps it soft, clean, and long-lasting.

Perfect for everyday wear or special occasions when you want to smell fresh, neat, and modern.

products.title: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau De Parfum is a very masculine perfume that is rich, warm, and creamy and at the same time it is classy and bold. Its first impression comes with a spicy aroma of cardamom and saffron which has a mixed taste of sweet and sharp at the same time. Then the cardamom and saffron gradually fade away into a creamy kulfi and a floral heart which is smooth and special. The base composed of vanilla, amber, and sandalwood gives the fragrance a deep and a very long-lasting quality. This perfume is for the self-confident man who is also luxurious and wants to be perfect for extraordinary occasions.

products.title: Armaf Hunter Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Hunter Intense Eau de Parfum is a masculine woody aromatic fragrance from the house of Armaf. It starts with a burst of citrus freshness from bergamot, pomelo, mandarin, orange and lemon and in the middle notes, a floral twist with lavender, geranium, tuberose and ylang-ylang then balances freshness with elegance. The final notes end in a warm and spicy trail of black pepper and cardamom, creating a bold yet smooth finish. This fragrance is designed for men who like energetic, confident and modern scents that last throughout the day.

products.title: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum is a bright and citrus scent crafted for women who love sweet, creamy and sparkling fragrances which is launched in 2025 it brings together a combination of zesty lemon and bergamot with smooth vanilla and white flowers at the opening. The middle shines with notes of rum, sugar, orange blossom, honey and whipped cream giving it a delicious dessert like feel. The final notes are caramel, tonka, musk and creamy vanilla wrapping the scent into a long-lasting sweet trail that feels both joyful and addictive.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Universe Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Art of Universe is a new female and male citrus aromatic perfume. This is a new fragrance. The Art of Universe was introduced in 2025. The aroma starts with fresh mandarin, bergamot, mint and a spicy touch of ginger. Pear and orange blossom are used in the heart to add some soft sweetness and smoothness. Musk, amber and cedar base provide a warm woody finish which remains well-behaved on the skin hours later.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal SILVERSHADE HOMME Deodorant is a 200ml non-alcoholic body spray designed for men who value invigorating freshness and modern style. This dynamic fresh deodorant opens with an uplifting blend of citrus and fruity notes, instantly energising your senses. The heart reveals aromatic florals paired with cool spices, adding a sophisticated layer. A base of soft woods and musk ensures a smooth, lasting finish that feels clean and assured.

products.title: Bvlgari Wood Essence Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum is a bold, refreshing, and modern fragrance crafted for the urban man who never loses his connection to nature. It beautifully blends strong woody notes with fresh citrus and earthy green tones, making it perfect for men who are grounded yet ambitious.

Inspired by the harmony between nature and city life, Bvlgari Man Wood Essence gives off the feeling of a calm forest breeze in the middle of a city. It’s rich, smooth, and vibrant, a perfect choice for men who want their fragrance to be fresh but also deep and masculine.

products.title: Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette is a fresh, sporty men’s perfume from Nautica Fragrances. It is a clean ocean style scent made with sea notes, citrus and sea salt in the opening; apple, geranium, palm leaf and green pepper in the middle; and musk, vetiver, patchouli and Brazilian redwood in the base. The smell feels fresh, salty, green and a little woody, giving a cool beach day vibe that is easy to wear and not heavy.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum is a classy and timeless perfume for men that combines modern freshness with warm woods. Launched in 2015, it brings together citrusy top notes of neroli and bergamot, followed by a spicy core of black pepper, lavender and cardamom. The base is creamy and masculine with vetiver, oakmoss, leather, iris and oud. It’s a perfume that wraps around you a feeling of elegance, confidence and being dressed up throughout the day.

products.title: Armaf Tag Him Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Tag Him Eau de Parfum is a men’s fragrance from the house of Armaf. It carries a strong woody spicy DNA that combines fresh citrus and spicy notes with warm woody accords. The opening comes alive with grapefruit, lemon, bergamot, and pink pepper, leading into a spicy heart of ginger, mint, lavender, and nutmeg. The scent finishes with earthy and deep base notes of vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood, and cedar. The combination is modern, youthful, and designed for men who enjoy energy and confidence in their fragrance.

products.title: Ajmal Sacred Love Femme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal SACRED LOVE Deodorant is a 200ml non-alcoholic women’s body spray that celebrates femininity and grace. This exquisite Ajmal Sacred Love deodorant opens with a refreshing blend of citrus and delicate fruits, creating an uplifting first impression. The heart blossoms into a lush bouquet of florals, perfectly balanced by warm woody and musky undertones that linger beautifully on the skin.

products.title: Mancera  Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum is a deeper, more decadent version of the original Cedrat Boise. This Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum feels bolder, smoother and more long lasting on the skin. It starts with fresh citrus aromas, blended with black currant and spice, for a sharp, classy opening. Leather, sandalwood, oud, patchouli and jasmine all intertwine and combine to form a warm, rather smoky heart as it settles. It is creamy, musky at the base, contains ambergris, oakmoss, vanilla and white musk and lasts hours and hours on the skin.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette is a cheerful, fresh, fun and lively women’s fragrance that literally encapsulates summer. Light Blue opens bright and transparent with a shocking burst of Sicilian lemon, Granny Smith apple, cedar, and soft bellflower akin to the scent of an early cool morning soft breeze; incredibly pleasant! Light Blue has a slight playful nature, while bamboo, jasmine, and rose enhance its buoyancy and elegance. Light Blue dries down smooth and enjoyable with cedarwood, clean musk, and a gentle bit of amber, leaving a subtle but long-lasting impression on your skin.

products.title: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum is a bold, deep, and mysterious fragrance designed for the modern man who lives confidently and makes a strong impression. Launched in 2018, Azzaro Wanted By Night EDP brings a unique blend of spicy cinnamon, fresh citrus, and rich woody notes, making it a perfect scent for evenings, special events, and cooler days.

Wanted By Night Eau De Parfum is intense and sensual, made for those who own the night. With its warm, spicy character and deep masculine vibe, Azzaro Wanted By Night is often described as charismatic and seductive, ideal for parties, dates, and night outs.

products.title: Al Haramain L'aventure Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Al Haramain L'aventure Eau De Parfum is a fresh, confident, and magnetic fragrance for the modern man who loves adventure. This perfume is an amazing blend of fresh citrus, rich woods, and warm musk that creates a memorable scent experience. It smells like success and confidence in a bottle.

L'aventure is incredibly versatile and loved for its ability to draw compliments. It’s perfect for the man who wants a signature scent that is both energetic and elegant. One spray of Al Haramain L'aventure makes you feel ready to conquer the day, whether you're in a business meeting or on a weekend trip.

products.title: French Avenue Fierte Luna Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Fierte Luna Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume made for people who enjoy sweet citrus scents with a warm touch. It opens fresh and clean with lavender, bergamot and lemon, which feels bright and uplifting from the first spray. In the middle, the scent becomes soft and cozy with honey, cinnamon, jasmine and cashmeran, giving it a slightly sweet, creamy feel. The base is warm and addictive with vanilla, tobacco leaf and tonka bean.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum is the new-age scent of modern confidence. It’s a fragrance that celebrates being your true self, fresh, clean, and effortlessly stylish. Created for the man who is not afraid to show his sensitive side, this perfume beautifully combines bright citrus with a clean floral heart and a warm, woody base.

YSL Myslf is incredibly versatile and easy to wear. It’s the perfect companion for every part of your day, from a busy morning at the office to a relaxed evening with friends. A spray of Yves Saint Laurent Myslf feels like putting on your favorite crisp shirt, it gives you a boost of freshness and makes you feel put-together and ready for anything.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Eau De Parfum is a clean, soft, and refreshing unisex scent that feels simple yet very elegant. It opens with bright citrusy notes of bergamot and orange, giving a fresh and uplifting start. In the middle of the fragrance are vanilla and pear, which produce a very smooth and creamy sweetness and are very pleasant to smell. At last, it is the warm musk and amber in the base that make it cozy, last a long time, and are suitable for daily use.

products.title: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette is a unisex fragrance that blends fresh, floral, and woody notes to create a calm and natural vibe. Launched in 1996, it opens with a combination of lavender, citrus, and mint for a fresh start. The middle notes have soft floral and green notes like jasmine, peach, and magnolia. The base is warm and comforting with musk, sandalwood, cedar, vanilla, and amber, giving a smooth finish for everyday wear.

products.title: Xerjoff Naxos Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Xerjoff Naxos Eau De Parfum is a vibrant and sweet unisex scent that has the character of being warm and rich. The opening is marked by radiant lemon, bergamot, and lavender notes that are both fresh and spirited. The creamy, warm, and sugary heart created by honey, cinnamon, jasmine, and cashmeran is present in the fragrance. The soft, lingering heat produced by the combination of vanilla, tonka bean, and tobacco leaf is the foundation. This perfume has a character that is chic, contemporary, and fit for all, especially the ones who adore sweet and bold scents.

products.title: Tom Ford Tuscan Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tuscan Leather Eau De Parfum is a powerful and daring leather scent that gives the impression of being luxurious, dark and elegant. The beginning of the fragrance is a little fruity with the raspberry combined with the saffron, which gives the impression of being a bit sweet and spicy. Gradually, it goes to the smoky and floral heart that feels deep and smooth. The base is all leather and suede, and it is warm, powerful, and long-lasting. This perfume is confident, mature, and luxurious, and it is ideal for bold fragrance lovers.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum was launched in 2024 as a light and breezy unisex fragrance with refreshing citrus, bergamot, and mint top notes; aromatic spices, lavender, and geranium heart notes; and soft and warm musk, woods, and amber base notes. A couple of spritz of Frose Ice EDP in the morning keeps you refreshed and energized throughout the day.

products.title: Lattafa Ejaazi Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ejaazi Eau De Parfum is a creamy, bold and classy scent for both men and women. It mixes fresh citrus and spicy notes with a warm woody base that makes it perfect for all-day wear. The perfume presents a citrus explosion of orange and cardamom, then the sweet patchouli comes along with the hot pepper. The base notes give a thick combination of amber, cedar, vetiver and oakmoss which makes it really charming and powerful.

products.title: Ajmal  Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance made for people who like fresh notes with a deep oud base. It opens with a clean and fresh mix of citrus, bergamot and mint, which feels bright and energetic. The middle is formed of the gentle flowers and the warm spices of such as neroli, ginger, rose and nutmeg that give it a smooth balance. The base settles into a creamy combination of oud, amber, musk and tonka bean, thus imparting warmth, comfort and longevity to the fragrance.

products.title: Byredo Bal D'afrique Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum is a warm and elegant unisex fragrance inspired by African culture and Parisian spirit. Launched in 2009, this scent beautifully combines citrus, floral, and woody notes in a smooth balance. It opens with fresh Amalfi lemon, marigold, bergamot, black currant, and African orange flower. The middle notes of violet, cyclamen, and jasmine give it a soft floral charm, while the base of vetiver, musk, amber, and Virginia cedar adds depth and long-lasting warmth.

products.title: Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum is a bold, classy, and warm fragrance that speaks of timeless elegance. Inspired by the royal city of Jaipur, this perfume blends zesty citrus, rich spices, and smooth vanilla for a scent that feels both powerful and comforting.

From the very first spray, fresh lemon and lemon verbena awaken your senses with a burst of energy. Soon, the heart reveals warm cinnamon and nutmeg, wrapping you in a spicy embrace. As it settles, creamy vanilla and woody notes create a deep, smooth finish that stays with you for hours.

Boucheron Homme Jaipur Eau De Parfum is perfect for men who love confident, long-lasting fragrances that leave a mark wherever they go. Whether you are at a wedding, a formal dinner, or an evening out, this scent makes sure you’re remembered.

products.title: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette is a fresh unisex fragrance from the house of Calvin Klein. Launched in 2017, it carries the modern spirit of youth and freedom with a clean citrus profile. The perfume opens with a burst of bergamot, mandarin orange, and grapefruit blossom giving a bright and zesty start. The heart notes bring out jasmine, rhubarb, freesia, and lily adding a soft floral touch with a hint of green freshness. Finally, the dry down settles into warm and smooth notes of musk, amber, and vetiver, making it a balanced scent that feels both uplifting and comforting.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Couture Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Couture Noir Eau de Parfum is an affordable, luxurious, and unisex signature perfume from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. It is an interesting take on modern citrusy and crispy fruity notes of lemon and apple with warmer and heavier leather, patchouli, amber, and musk with a bit of nature-based accords of lily of the valley and oakmoss.

products.title: Armaf Ventana Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Ventana Eau de Parfum is a modern men’s fragrance from the house of Armaf. Launched in 2017, it is a fresh yet deep scent that combines citrus and woody tones beautifully. The perfume opens with a shot of grapefruit, lemon, and mandarin orange. The middle brings calming lavender, geranium, vetiver, and patchouli, while the base settles into amber, sandalwood, cedar, and precious woods. It is a bold, energetic fragrance that gives a classy vibe for all-day wear.

products.title: French Avenue Essence de Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Essence de Blanc Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and airy unisex fragrance made for daily wear. It was launched in 2022 and opens with bright citrus and green notes that feel light and refreshing from the first spray. As it settles, soft, spicy and minty tones come forward, giving a calm and cooling feel. The base is smooth and slightly aquatic with ambergris and soft floral notes, making the scent feel modern, new and easy to wear.

products.title: Dunhill Signature Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: The Dunhill Signature Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean perfume that is bright and classy on the skin of men. It starts off with a citrusy burst of lemon, bergamot and orange that is very fresh and invigorating. Gradually, it passes into a creamy centre of neroli, green tea and light spices, which are soothing and graceful. Vetiver, musk and soft woods form the base to providea clean woody finish which remains fresh on skin. This perfume is relaxed, luxurious and easy to wear.

products.title: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum is an unisex perfume that is soft but mysterious, and clean, musky, and faintly woody. It begins with a fresh touch of pear, apple and a sweet tang of citrus, which is airy and smooth. Gradually, the ambrette and the jasmine enter, with a warm musky touch. During the dry down, Iso E Super and Cetalox form a skin-like woody smell that is close to the skin but is long-lasting. It is contemporary, sparse, and subdued hard.

products.title: Riiffs Rose de Soleil Eclat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Rose de Soleil Éclat Eau de Parfum is a bright and fruity floral fragrance for women that feels sweet, fresh, and warm. The opening is juicy and lively with mango, Sicilian lemon, wild berries, and a soft touch of pink pepper. Slowly, the heart turns creamy and slightly spicy with ginger and jasmine, blended with smooth tonka bean and vanilla. In the dry down, white musk, amber, and vetiver give a clean, soft, and long-lasting finish. It feels sunny, feminine, and perfect for everyday wear.

products.title: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum is one of those perfumes that are warm, daring, and classic all at once, and the oriental richness is definitely the main reason for its popularity among perfume lovers. It starts with citrus notes, illuminating bergamot and lemon, then goes into a deep floral-earthy heart consisting of iris, jasmine, rose, vetiver, and patchouli, finally ending in a soft base of vanilla, incense, leather, sandalwood, and musk. It is perceived as classic, smooth, slightly smoky, and elegant with a very effortless touch.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum is a rich and modern unisex perfume with a strong oriental touch. It starts with a fruity and spicy mixture of mango, saffron, citrus and soft florals that are bright but warm at the same time. The middle note is amber, rose, iris and black tea that are smooth and slightly smoky. The base is deep, woody and very long lasting with oud, tonka bean, patchouli, musk and cedar, which gives it a bold and classy finish that feels lavish but is still easy to wear.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau De Parfum special fragrance is perfect for both men and women who love a warm, woody scent with a touch of elegance. Dirham Oud is a beautiful combination of fresh notes and deep, earthy tones, creating a perfume that feels both modern and classic.

This fragrance is a journey for your senses. It starts with a bright and zesty burst of fruits, then moves to a soft floral heart, and finally settles into a powerful, lasting base of woods and oud. It's a scent that makes you feel confident and sophisticated, perfect for any occasion where you want to make a statement.

products.title: Acqua Di Parma Ginepro Di Sardegna Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Perfumer Mélanie Carestia formulated Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo – Ginepro di Sardegna Eau de Toilette for men and women in 2014 starting with a base of Virginia Ceder, a heart of clean and green sage and cypress mixed with a twist of spicy and citrusy accords of Juniper, pepper, allspice, nutmeg, bergamot. It is widely recognized as “Most Sensual Acqua di Parma Perfume with Juniper” by fragrance enthusiasts and has been ranked among the Top Blu Mediterraneo fragrances.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Odyssey White Eau de Parfum is a men’s fragrance from the popular house of Armaf it starts with spicy pink pepper, citrus yuzu and fresh grapefruit that give an energetic start and in the middle violet leaf and sea notes add a soft, clean and slightly green touch. The end notes are warm and woody with amber, amberwood and guaiac wood making it a balanced everyday perfume. It feels refreshing, youthful and modern perfect for men who like a combination of freshness with warmth.

products.title: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum, a fresh and powerful fragrance for men, is a perfect choice for those who want to stay bright, clean, and lively. The fragrance starts with a strong and very fresh burst of citrus notes that are really energizing. Gradually, it goes to a spicy and slightly sweet heart that provides depth and balance. The base is woody and musky, resulting in a smooth and long-lasting finish. This scent is modern, confident, and bold, absolutely perfect for men who prefer fresh but strong perfumes.

products.title: Lattafa Ra'ed Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ra’ed Silver Eau de Parfum is a warm and spicy unisex scent with a bright citrus opening and a deep, sweet, woody base. It starts with fresh hints of citruses, spices and mandarin orange, then moves into a rich heart of cinnamon, saffron, amber and cloves. The base settles into soft vanilla, musk, leather, oud and a touch of ambergris.

products.title: Davidoff Essentials Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Davidoff Essentials Blue Eau de Toilette is the everyday perfume that offers a clean and fresh smell to men. The perfume starts with citrus, mint and lavender, which is refreshing and invigorating. The perfume is formed together with jasmine and basil which produce a light spicy scent. The final stage is due to the amber, musk and cedarwood that form a smooth woody scent. The perfume comes out as a simple male fragrance that is appropriate for everyday usage.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toillete for Woman
products.body_html: Light Blue Eau De Toilette Dolce Gabbana is a fresh and iconic floral fruity perfume. It was released in 2001 and designed by perfumer Olivier Cresp. The smell starts with sparkling Sicilian lemon and apple, which provides a fresh and crisp touch with a light woody scent of cedar and bellflower. Then it passes to the soft notes of jasmine, white rose, and bamboo to make it light and feminine. Musk, amber and cedar form the foundation of the clean and smooth finish that is fresh throughout the day.

products.title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau De Parfum is a bold and fresh men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Bvlgari. Launched in 2016, this perfume is inspired by the power of the Tiger’s Eye stone, symbolising strength and confidence. The fragrance opens with the brightness of grapefruit, combining into spicy and musky tones of ginger and ambrette, and settles into a smooth base of ambroxan, musk, vetiver, and patchouli. A perfect scent for men who love a fresh, strong, and modern aroma.

products.title: French Avenue Pinnace Oryn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Pinnace Oryn Eau de Parfum is a fresh and energetic citrus perfume made for men who like clean and bright scents. Launched in 2025, this fragrance opens with juicy mandarin, orange and bergamot that feel fresh and uplifting from the first spray. The heart has a spicy ginger note that adds a sharp and warm touch. The base settles into smooth ambergris, giving the scent a soft, masculine finish that stays pleasant and classy.

products.title: Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau De Toilette is a fresh, masculine fragrance inspired by the deep blue sea and the energy of ocean waves. It’s a scent that feels clean, refreshing, and full of life, perfect for men who want to smell crisp and confident all day.

The fragrance opens with a burst of juicy mandarin and orange, blended with the green freshness of petitgrain. At the heart, unique marine notes of seaweed meet soft lavender and cotton flower, giving it a cool yet sophisticated vibe. The base brings warmth and depth with Virginia cedar, patchouli, clary sage, and amber, making it long-lasting and memorable.

Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme is like stepping out of the ocean on a sunny day, fresh, cool, and effortlessly stylish. It’s perfect for men who want a clean signature scent for daily wear.

products.title: Creed Viking Cologne Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Viking Cologne EDP for men is a bold and invigorating fragrance inspired by strength and adventure. It opens with fresh and zesty top notes of mandarin orange, lemon, pink pepper, and bergamot. The heart blends aromatic lavender, geranium, rosemary, sage, and nutmeg, creating a dynamic and spicy character. The base settles into warm and earthy notes of vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, olibanum, and patchouli, giving it depth and lasting power. Viking Cologne is admired in the fragrance community for its balanced blend of citrus, spices, and woods, offering good projection and longevity.

products.title: Louis Vuitton On The Beach Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton On The Beach Eau De Parfum is a fresh, bright and uplifting unisex scent inspired by warm sunshine and calm sea breeze. It mixes sparkling citrus with soft floral and warm herbal notes that feel clean, salty and smooth on the skin. The blend opens with juicy yuzu and sweet neroli, then moves into a warm mix of rosemary, thyme, sand, pink pepper and clove. The dry down settles nicely with cypress, giving a green and airy vibe that feels like standing close to the ocean shore.

products.title: Louis Vuitton California Dreams Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton California Dreams Eau de Parfum is a soft, dreamy citrus fragrance made for people who enjoy a fresh, clean, and warm scent. It opens with a bright mandarin orange that feels like a sunny day, followed by a soft mix of pear and ambrette that adds a sweet-musky touch. As it dries down, gentle musk and benzoin create a warm and cozy base, giving the fragrance a simple but beautiful glow that feels like a sunset at the beach.

products.title: Creed Royal Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Royal Oud EDP is made for men and women. This perfume is a sophisticated perfume with a spicy and citrusy start moving into warm and woody middle notes and finishing with an elegant base. It opens with top notes of pink pepper, lemon and Sicilian bergamot which give a fresh and amazing impression. The middle notes of cedar, angelica and galbanum add a woody and green touch while the base of sandalwood, agarwood and musk leaves a smooth and long-lasting scent on skin and clothes.

products.title: Acqua Di Parma Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Acqua di Parma Leather EDP for men and women is a sophisticated and luxurious evening perfume with a rich citrusy opening with Brazilian orange, Sicilian lemon, and raspberry top notes; aromatic and leather-balancing red thyme, rose, petitgrain, and honeysuckle heart notes; and a polished base of leather, cedarwood, and guaiac wood. It was formulated by François Demachy in 2019. 

It is highly praised among the fragrance community as a highly refined and exceptional blend of notes with a distinguished quality and satisfactory projection & sillage.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume with a fresh and clean character. It is very refreshing and uplifting due to its bright citrus opening smell. The aroma’s development gives a very soft aromatic touch that is very light and comfortable to the nose like the beautiful skin. Essentially, this perfume is a simple and fresh daily use fragrance for the wearers who prefer clean and unobtrusive yet recognizable scents.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau De Toilette is a beautiful scent in the Woody Floral Musk group, made to capture a feeling of peaceful, quiet calm and easy elegance. It starts with a citrusy smell of Mandarin. The middle of the scent moves into a smooth, dry softness, where the gentle touch of White Tea is nicely lifted by the soft, almost powdery feel of Iris and a light, green herb note. The final part rests on a comforting, skin-close foundation: three quiet Musks blend with warm, comforting Madras Wood and Ambrette Seed, creating a subtle, lasting fragrance that feels polished and lovely for wearing every day.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Scent Spray Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Scent Spray Eau De Parfum was launched in 1999. This citrus aromatic fragrance for women is an absolute favourite of working and easy-going women. Francis Kurkdijian is the perfumer behind this absolute fragrance. The top notes of this scent include Lemon, Bergamot, Mint, Orange Peel and Rhubarb. While the heart tones and the dried tones include Jasmine, Musk, Oakmoss, Fennel, Carnation, White Amber, Musk, Oakmoss, Celery Seeds, Caraway, Cloves and Amber.

products.title: Bentley Silverlake Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Bentley For Men Silverlake Eau De Parfum is a fresh, modern, and masculine fragrance that captures the spirit of adventure. Inspired by clear mountain air and sparkling lakes, this scent combines crisp citrus with cool aromatic notes, creating an energising and refreshing experience.

The fragrance opens with a shot of zesty lemon and cool mint, instantly boosting your freshness. At its heart, violet leaves, lavender, and pink pepper add a clean, slightly spicy, and green touch, making it both elegant and sporty. The base of white musk and amberwood brings a smooth, warm, and long-lasting finish.

Bentley For Men Silverlake Eau De Parfum exudes a classy yet casual charm, perfect for the man who appreciates both sophistication and the great outdoors. One spray is like stepping into a crisp morning by a mountain lake, surrounded by fresh air and endless horizons.

products.title: BDK Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: BDK Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum is a fresh unisex perfume from the French perfume house BDK Parfums which was launched in 2020 this fragrance is made by perfumer Ralf Schewieger and captures the joy of the Mediterranean summers. It opens with Italian lemon, neroli, Italian mandarin and fig that give a juicy citrus and the middle notes bring green notes, watery touches, eucalyptus, orange blossom, strawberry, immortelle and jasmine which together feel airy and refreshing. The base is warm and grounding with Haitian vetiver, white musk, tonka bean and Indonesian patchouli leaf making it a smooth combination of fresh and woody accords.

products.title: Bath & Body Works Gingham Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: Gingham by Bath & Body Works is a Citrus fragrance for women. Gingham was launched in 2019.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense For Woman Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Light Blue Eau Intense for women by Dolce & Gabbana boasts a refreshing Mediterranean summer character. It contains a citrus and green apple head note that transitions to soft, feminine floral notes resting on a warm, musky amberwood base. The perfume opens with lemon and Granny Smith apple, along with the heart note of jasmine and marigold, and rests on a gorgeous base of amberwood and musk. This is a bold and strong Eau De Parfum that lasts longer than earlier releases. Additionally, it offers versatility to wear every day, or as a complex fragrance, suitable for occasions that call for it.

products.title: Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum is a perfume for both men and women. It feels warm, a bit mysterious, and very rich when you wear it. The perfume is inspired by saffron, which is a very special spice. It has a combination of sweet, spicy, and earthy smell that make it bold but still very elegant.

The perfume start with saffron, juniper berries and fresh citrus from Chinese grapefruit, giving a spicy and bright opening. In the middle, you get soft leather and gentle black violet that add some depth and floral touch. Later it settle down into raspberry, cashmeran and vetiver, which give a woody, musky and little sweet finish that stay for long.

products.title: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and bright unisex fragrance from the luxury house of Tom Ford. Inspired by the Italian Riviera, this perfume feels like a cool sea breeze mixed with fresh citrus fruits and white flowers. It opens with sharp and juicy citrus notes blended with soft herbs, then moves into smooth neroli and orange flower and finally settles into a light musky and amber base.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette is a stylish and fresh perfume for men, perfect for daily wear or casual evenings. It opens with fresh citrusy and aromatic notes, then moves into a smooth almond and tonka bean heart, finishing with a warm and masculine base of leather, cedar, and vetiver. It is loved by men for its balanced and long-lasting scent that feels natural yet sophisticated.

products.title: Neesh Cologne Sophistique Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Cologne Sophistique Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, clean and classy men’s perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent is made for men who like a neat, modern and confident smell. It opens with bright citrus notes that feel fresh and energizing, then slowly moves into soft florals and green tones. Smooth, warm and slightly creamy with woods, musk and vanilla is the base, which gives a polished touch but at the same time is suitable for everyday wear.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum is a tender, sweet and touch spicy female perfume that is rich and contemporary in its touch and feel. The introduction is sweet and crisp with plump rambutan and grapefruit with a touch of cardamom. Bulgarian rose and peony make their appearance in the heart with a touch of romantic floral flavour sprinkled with blackcurrant sweetness. Caramel and incense base is creamy, warm and a bit smoky and thus long-lasting and elegant. This perfume is feminine, self-confident, and suitable for those women who admire sweet flowers with a warm touch.

products.title: Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum For Her
products.body_html: Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum is a women's perfume of a floral nature. It was introduced in 2010 and is renowned for its soft, fresh, and feminine smell. The fragrance starts with peony, citrus and mandarin orange that provide a fresh and light beginning to it. The heart contains roses and osmanthus, giving a floral smoothness. Sandalwood and patchouli are used in the base to produce a warm and classy finish that remains soft on the skin.

products.title: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau de Parfum is a bright and tropical unisex perfume that captures the fresh breeze of the Caribbean islands. The creators, Olivier Creed and Erwin Creed, introduced this perfume in 2007. With lime, coconut, and rum being the primary notes of this scent, it takes you to a sunny beach in an instant. The smoothness and refreshing of the holiday mood that this fragrance brings can be enjoyed by anyone who loves to smell beachy and feel-good scents.

products.title: Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum (2024)
products.body_html:
Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum is a bold, classy, and refreshing fragrance made for royalty and for those who live like one. Inspired by the Duke of Windsor and the upscale Mayfair district in London, this scent feels luxurious, clean, and crisp. It perfectly blends aromatic, floral, and green notes with a soft woody base to create a refined signature scent.

Creed Royal Mayfair smells like confidence in a bottle. It starts fresh and sharp, thanks to British gin and lime, and then flows into sweet rose and smooth eucalyptus, finishing with soft cedarwood. Whether you’re heading to a formal dinner, an office meeting, or a classy brunch, Royal Mayfair will leave a polished and sophisticated impression.

products.title: Tom Ford Oud Voyager Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Oud Voyager Eau de Parfum is a rich and spicy woody fragrance for women and men. It opens with fresh geranium, pink pepper, and a touch of citrus that feels bright and slightly sharp. After some time, the heart becomes warm with red peony, cardamom, and saffron, giving a soft spicy feel. In the base, oud, vetiver, patchouli, and musk create a deep, smoky, and long-lasting trail. It feels bold, elegant, and perfect for someone who likes strong woody scents.

products.title: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and timeless fragrance that captures the spirit of coastal luxury and warm sunshine. Created by the House of Creed in 1995, this iconic scent is loved by both men and women for its clean, citrusy freshness with a smooth musky finish.

Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de fragrance opens with a burst of juicy fruits and sea breeze, making you feel like you’re walking along a royal Mediterranean coast. As it develops, warm woods and musk add depth and sophistication, making it a perfect choice for those who want a scent that’s both refreshing and classy.

Creed Millésime Impérial is a fragrance that fits every season and every occasion. Whether it’s a sunny day, a romantic evening, or a formal event, this perfume makes you feel confident, clean, and irresistible.

products.title: Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Eau de Parfum is a fresh, bright and relaxing unisex fragrance inspired by the Italian coast. The fragrance feels very natural, sunny and clean on the skin. The very beginning of the fragrance is dominated by succulent citruses and green herbs, that is, crispness and cheerfulness. The middle notes present a mild floral and spicy aspect, whereas the base remains muted, warm and musky.

products.title: Men Office Discovery Set - Montblanc Explorer, Prada L'homme, Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver
products.body_html:
Elevate your professional presence with our Men Office Discovery Set, featuring three premium fragrances:

  • Montblanc Explorer EDP: Embrace adventure with this bold, woody scent that exudes confidence and determination.
  • Prada L'Homme EDT: Experience refined elegance with a sophisticated blend of floral and amber notes, perfect for the modern gentleman.
  • Terre d'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver EDP: Discover a fresh, earthy fragrance that combines vetiver with spicy and citrus undertones, ideal for making a lasting impression.

Perfectly curated for the modern professional, these scents embody elegance and confidence, making every day at the office exceptional.

products.title: Orto Parisi Bergamask Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Orto Parisi Bergamask Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that mixes fresh citrus with soft florals and warm woods. The fragrance was introduced in 2014 and its initial notes are bright and sharp with bergamot and lemon, then it goes into the floral note of lavender, orange blossom and lily of the valley and finally to a warm musk, cedar and tonka.

products.title: Men Date Night Discovery Set - Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme, Versace Eros Flame, Guerlain L'homme Ideal
products.body_html:
Make a lasting impression with our Men Date Night Discovery Set, featuring three captivating fragrances:

  • Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme EDP: Ignite the night with the intense blend of spices, vanilla, and tobacco, creating a warm and seductive scent.
  • Versace Eros Flame EDP: Embrace the passionate and vibrant notes of Italian citrus, black pepper, and vanilla, perfect for an unforgettable evening.
  • Guerlain L'Homme Ideal EDP: Experience the alluring combination of almond, leather, and tonka bean, delivering a sophisticated and magnetic fragrance.

Curated for romantic occasions, these fragrances are designed to captivate and enchant.

products.title: Estee Lauder Pleasure For Men Eau De Cologne
products.body_html: Estee Lauder Pleasures For Men is a fresh, bright, and simple smell that has been a long-time favorite since the late 90s. The scent of this Eau De Parfum starts with grapefruit and watery notes, mixed with a smooth, soft sweetness from nectarine. The middle tone is warmer and spicy with ginger, peppery pimento, and clean lavender, which gives the cologne its manly feel. All of this settles onto a nice, solid base of deep sandalwood, warm ebony wood, and oakmoss. This whole scent feels like a relaxed, sunny afternoon.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Citrus Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Citrus Oud Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is refreshing and fragrant but still in the wood category, and it is designed for both female and male. It starts with a bright mix of mandarin and cardamom which is blended in a clean and spicy way. While it is getting prepared to settle down, soft jasmine, and woody notes take over, which creates a smooth and classy atmosphere. The base of oud, patchouli, musk, and cedarwood adds richness and longevity. This fragrance feels luxurious, contemporary, and comfortable to wear.

products.title: Lalique  White Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Lalique White Eau De Toilette is a fresh Citrus aromatic men's fragrance. It is clean, sharp and classy as soon as it sprays on. The introduction is sunny and lemon leaf and bergamot create a cool and somewhat tangy impression. It is smooth and settles down, unearthing soft spices such as white pepper and cardamom. The cedar and the musk provide a smooth woody foundation in the dry down, which remains on the skin.

products.title: Women Daytime Discovery Set - Giorgio Armani Si Fiori, Ysl Libre, Giorgio Armani In Love With You
products.body_html:
Brighten your day with elegance and charm with our Women Daytime Discovery Set, featuring three delightful fragrances:

  • Giorgio Armani Si Fiori EDP: Embrace the delicate blend of floral and citrus notes, creating a fresh and radiant scent that’s perfect for daytime wear.
  • YSL Libre EDP: Experience the bold fusion of lavender essence and orange blossom, offering a powerful and sophisticated fragrance for the confident woman.
  • Giorgio Armani In Love With You EDP: Enjoy the modern and captivating scent of fruity and floral notes, embodying youthful energy and passion.

Curated for the modern woman, these fragrances are perfect for enhancing your daytime presence.

products.title: Tiffany & Co. Tiffany Eau De Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Tiffany & Co. Tiffany Eau De Parfum Intense is a rich and elegant floral women’s perfume who love classy and soft luxury. It opens fresh and bright, then slowly turns creamy, floral and slightly sweet on the skin. The scent starts with juicy pear, pink pepper and green mandarin leaf that feels fresh but smooth. In the middle, iris stands out beautifully with jasmine and rose, offering it a clean and powdery floral touch. The base is warm and comforting with vanilla, musk, amber, benzoin and cashmeran, making it last long and feel very cozy.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Castley Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Castley Eau de Parfum is a fresh, spicy, citrus scent for men from the luxury house of Parfums de Marly. Launched in 2025, it opens with bright, energetic notes of bergamot, grapefruit, ginger and black pepper that give a sharp, fresh start. The middle comes with neroli, petitgrain, pepper, timur and rose, which adds a little spicy floral touch. The base settles into warm notes of akigalawood, benzoin, labdanum and leather, making it smooth, classy and slightly bold but still fresh and clean.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Moscow Mule Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Moscow Mule Eau de Parfum is a citrus aromatic perfume for both women and men. Moscow Mule was launched in 2017. The nose of Romano Ricci backs this perfume. It starts on new notes of Bergamot, Lime, and Lemon. Ginger, Hedione, and Apple are added to the heart, giving the heart a spicy and slightly fruity touch. It is drying down to White Musk, Woody Notes, Ambrette, and Amberwood and has a clean and smooth finish to it.

products.title: Floraiku Between Two Trees Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Floraiku Between Two Trees Eau de Parfum feels like a quiet walk in nature on a fresh morning. It opens with the lively brightness of Grapefruit, giving a burst of energy that feels crisp and light. The scent slowly moves into the green heart of Mate, which adds a calm, earthy tone that feels warm and slightly smoky. The final note is woody and grounded, leaving behind a nice and clean trail of timeless fragrance. It is a perfect fit for someone looking for a gentle yet expressive fragrance. It gives off a fresh and outdoor-like feel, and is apt to wear at any occasion at any time of the day.

products.title: Cartier Baiser Vole Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Cartier Baiser Vole Eau De Parfum is a delicate floral perfume made for women. It opens with fresh and sparkling notes of lily and citrus, which gives a soft and elegant feel. The heart is pure lily, keeping the floral theme alive, while the base is green lily and fresh green notes that make the perfume natural, light, and refreshing. It is perfect for women who like soft, floral, and graceful scents that feel fresh all day.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Vetiver Paradise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Vetiver Paradise Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume with a fresh, woody, and spicy character. Launched in 2017, it combines bright citrus, warm spices, and earthy woody notes into a smooth and elegant composition. The perfume opens with fresh top notes of bergamot, grapefruit, and pink pepper, moves into a spicy and floral heart of neroli, nutmeg, and cardamom, and finally settles into a grounding base of vetiver and woody notes. It is a versatile scent perfect for daily wear or special occasions.

products.title: Al Haramain Makkah Attar Roll On
products.body_html: Makkah by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Citruses and Green Notes; middle notes are Big Strawberry, Orange Blossom and Jasmine; base notes are Resins, Amber, Powdery Notes, Vanilla and Musk.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Viper Green Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilo Viper Green Eau de Parfum is a truly confident and lively fragrance – it’s a natural scent. Viper Green is elegant and fully audacious at the same time and is a great fit for a person who likes the cool contrast of feeling fresh but warm at the same time. The scent has that luxury clean aspect, but that unique green bite, distinguishes it from the other standard citrus or floral fragrances out there. That specific citrus in woods helps Viper Green enact a niche in greater appeal with people who desire sophistication, but also differentiate it from traditional fragrance to one that exhibits an edge.

products.title: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum is a rich and sweet fragrance made for women who love warm and creamy scents. The opening feels nutty and smooth with black currant, hazelnut, milk and praline, giving a soft gourmand touch. In the heart, rose, jasmine, and iris add a floral beauty, while cacao brings a slight chocolate feel. The base is deep and warm with vanilla, honey, musk and sandalwood that stays on skin for long hours. It feels elegant, cozy and a little addictive.

products.title: Riiffs Surge & Spectra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs R Spectra Eau dePerfum is an assertive and hot fragrance that is both hot and somewhat sweet to the touch of the man. It has a combination of orange blossom and white pepper as the beginning, which makes it fresh and sharp. As it subsides, you have warm violet, nutmeg and sweetness. Amber, vanilla bean and patchouli provide a rich, smooth and extended low in the dry down. It is contemporary, masculine, and suitable for those men who use oriental spicy perfumes that are very rich.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum is a women's perfume that is warm and elegant, and it is sweet, flowery, and slightly spicy. It opens bright with bergamot, orange and blackcurrant combined with sweet notes and saffron to give it a good first impression. It is smooth and feminine, and as if out of nothing, slow and soft jasmine and violet emerge. The foundation of musk, amber, cashmeran, and moss remains long-lasting on the skin and is comfortable, deep, and luxurious for hours.

products.title: Men Luxe Discovery Set - Amouage Interlude, Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim, Acqua Di Parma Leather
products.body_html:
Indulge in luxury with our Men Luxe Discovery Set, featuring three exceptional fragrances:

  • Amouage Interlude EDP: Immerse yourself in a complex blend of spices, amber, and smoky accords, delivering a rich and captivating scent.
  • Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim EDP: Immerse yourself in a refreshing blend of citrus notes, delivering a vibrant and invigorating scent perfect for a sunlit adventure.
  • Acqua di Parma Leather EDP: Experience the refined leather accord, complemented by woody and citrus notes, embodying timeless luxury and sophistication.

Perfectly curated for the discerning gentleman, these scents exude opulence and class.
